_comment: Notes the build planner shows while a build guide's template is loaded unchanged. Keyed by build id (the file name in src/content/builds). 'text' is shown as written. 'missingWeapons' lists weapons the guide uses that may not be in standard-weapons.json yet, as [name, slot]: the template's plannerHash names them (for example w2s=P90), the planner fills the slot as soon as a weapon with that name exists, and the note only mentions the ones still missing.

tech-aegis-engineering-build-tampishach.text: Team Backup and Performance Enhancer show here under their in-game names, Combat Enhancer and Teamfight.

tactical-pharma-season-2-build-ggreborn.text: GGReborn doesn't say which two pieces are Fire Cycle, so this uses TikTokAndy's split from the same guide: body armor and holster.

aegis-team-healer-tech-operator-build-ti.text: The guide doesn't say which two of backpack, gloves and holster are Mechanical Expert; this puts it on gloves and holster.

any-weapon-commando-beginner-vanguard-bu.text: The guide doesn't say which of the last two pieces is the holster; this puts the Phalanx Attack piece there.
